name: Entropy

categories.label: VP tokens gained during the game
categories.hint: Sum of your Victory Point tokens.

categories.label: Lifeform Objective tiles
categories.hint: VP on claimed big and small Lifeform Objective tiles.

categories.label: Main Objective VP
categories.hint: VP from Main Objective progress and fulfilled conditions (per your mission card/objective).

categories.label: Remaining Life cards + Entropy + Mass + Energy
categories.labelVi: Bài Life, Entropy, Mass, Energy còn lại
categories.hint: Count all together; 1 VP per full 4 (not VP itself).

categories.label: VP for leftovers
categories.hint: 1 VP for every 4 remaining Life cards, Entropy, Mass and Energy combined.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players share the victory.

endCondition.description: Triggered when 2 Objectives are completed (rightmost Main Objective track space and/or claiming the big Lifeform Objective tile); finish the round, play one more round, then Final Scoring.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. The leftoverItems helper is a raw count (countsToTotal false); leftoverVp converts it at 1 VP per 4. Main Objective values depend on the chosen Main Objective tile (printed on the board/tiles), so the scorer enters the computed total. Solo mode and promos not modelled. Verified via a RulesPal mirror of the English rulebook, not the PDF.
